conflicts_notes: Current state Housing Authority law overrides older charter composition. Representative Town Meeting is 162 elected seats; three current occupants are one-year appointees filling elected seats.
Library Trustee two-year 2026 contest contains a declined candidate and write-ins; sixth current trustee identity remains unresolved instead of inferred.
All seven elected office groups have normalized seat counts, but multiple 2026-expiring incumbencies remain unresolved because a current official 2026 result was not located.
Open Town Meeting voters are not modeled. Housing Authority is normalized to three elected seats plus tenant/state appointees; several regulatory boards are explicitly appointed.
Voter-elected offices are Mayor, nine City Council seats, and six School Committee seats. Mayor's School Committee role is ex officio; City Clerk is not modeled as voter elected.
